# three.js, vendored

- **What:** three.js r170 (`three@0.170.0` from npm), unchanged. Only the three files the avatar viewer needs.
- **Licence:** MIT. See `LICENSE` in this folder.
- **Why it is here:** so GABRIEL's 3D avatar loads no script from the internet.
- **To update:** `npm pack three@<version>`, copy the same three files, and test `gabriel-3d.html`.
